question_text: A 45-year-old man comes to the physician because of a 5-day history of fever, malaise, and right upper abdominal pain. Examination of the abdomen shows tenderness in the right upper quadrant. His leukocyte count is 18,000/mm3 (90% neutrophils) and serum alkaline phosphatase is 130 U/L. Ultrasonography of the abdomen shows a 3-cm hypoechoic lesion in the right lobe of the liver with a hyperemic rim. Which of the following is the most likely underlying cause of this patient's condition?
